_meta.description: 200 body of GET /api/vehicles/{vehicleId}/invites (rest-api.md §7.5.2), verbatim from the spec example. Note the envelope key is `invites`, NOT `items`: this surface is deliberately unpaginated (no cursor, no hasMore) and the distinct key keeps an SDK pagination helper from mistaking it for a page. Revoked rows are never serialized, so a consumer never filters. `code`/`expiresAt` appear only on the pending row; `acceptedAt` only on the accepted one.
